    # Connect right beams
    if len(right_beams) >= 2:
        y_anchor = (right_beams[0].position.y + right_beams[1].position.y) / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(right_beams[1], right_beams[0], (x_right, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    # Connect left structure to middle beam at two points
    # Connect left beam at y=2.8 (index 3) and y=3.4 (index 4)
    anchor_x = (x_left + x_middle) / 2
    anchor_y = (left_beams[3].position.y + middle_beam.position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[3], middle_beam, (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')
    anchor_y = (left_beams[4].position.y + middle_beam.position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[4], middle_beam, (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    # Connect right structure to middle beam at two points
    # Connect right lower beam (y=3.0) and upper (y=6.0)
    anchor_x = (x_right + x_middle) / 2
    anchor_y = (right_beams[0].position.y + middle_beam.position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(right_beams[0], middle_beam, (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')
    anchor_y = (right_beams[1].position.y + middle_beam.position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(right_beams[1], middle_beam, (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    # Cross joints between left and right beams
    # Left lower (y=0.8) to right lower (y=3.0)
    cross_y = (left_beams[0].position.y + right_beams[0].position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[0], right_beams[0], (x_right, cross_y), type='rigid')

    # Left upper (y=6.2) to right upper (y=6.0)
    cross_y = (left_beams[-1].position.y + right_beams[1].position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[-1], right_beams[1], (x_right, cross_y), type='rigid')

    return left_beams[0]
